supplemental_reviewed_clauses.verbatim_extracted_text:
Any drug, which has never been imported into Laos or new drugs  produced for the treatment of serious diseases i.e. AIDS, hepatitis cancer, cardiovascular…may be considered by the following conditions:
(a)    The drug shall be registered in some countries, such as:
-          One of European Union Country;
-          United States of America;
-          Australia and
-          Japan
(b)   Additional necessary documents can be provided up on request e.g. Toxicology, Pharmacology, Pharmaco-kinetic, Bio-availability and clinical trials.
